audit_scope: UE experiment console source/static evidence after UE 004-008

proven: No live UE command echo receiver was present.
Existing UQuadrotorMworksUdpReceiverComponent is a quadrotor.unreal_state frame/status receiver, not a mosim.ue_command_echo.v1 receiver.
Future receiver must be a new project-owned command echo receiver/adapter feeding UQuadrotorMworksExperimentConsoleStateComponent.ApplyCommandEchoJson.
Known non-live labels are downgraded to smoke_only.
Receiver boundary checker passes with current_live_echo_receiver_present=false and safe_to_implement_runtime_receiver_next=false.
Compile-only UBT gate passed for MoSimSceneLibraryEditor Win64 Development.
Post-compile static source-label and receiver-boundary regressions passed.
still_unproven: No Unreal Editor GUI, PIE, packaged runtime, or live receiver run.

proven: Source/static disabled-state contract covers controller, planner, wind, fault, and map/scene controls.
Smoke/source/preflight rows stay smoke_only with accepted_as_runtime_ack=false.
Only future-live fixture rows can represent enabled_after_runtime_echo.
Future accepted-state fixture contract requires mosim.ue_command_echo.v1.
Future enabled accepted state requires authoritative source, command id, timestamp, accepted status, ack authority, command kind, and no_pose_overwrite_status=pass.
Smoke/source/preflight, rejected, authority-mismatch, and malformed fixture rows cannot be represented as runtime accepted.

recommended_next_safe_gates.summary: Define a source/static contract for a future new project-owned command echo receiver shell without implementing the receiver.
must_prove: Future receiver must not reuse UQuadrotorMworksUdpReceiverComponent or UQuadrotorMworksUdpCommandSenderComponent.
Future receiver input is mosim.ue_command_echo.v1 only.
Accepted runtime state requires authoritative source/transport provenance, run_id, request_id, seq, time_s, command.kind, ack_authority, status=accepted, and no_pose_overwrite_status=pass.
Frame/status downlink and UDP send success cannot become command acknowledgement.
recommended_next_safe_gates.why_next: 004-008 have enough source/static state and fixture safety to specify the future receiver boundary precisely, but MWORKS/ROS2 live transport is still blocked, so implementation remains unsafe.

recommended_next_safe_gates.summary: Define a source/static UI binding preflight contract for disabled states only, without editing Blueprint/UMG/assets or enabling controls.
must_prove: UI bindings must render smoke/source/preflight rows as disabled or review-required, never runtime accepted.
UI bindings must gate enabled accepted controls on future authoritative live echo rows only.
Planner/controller success labels are not UI command acknowledgement.
RViz2/FAST-LIO/planner review remains outside UE UI authority.
recommended_next_safe_gates.why_next: This can prepare the operator-console UI boundary while preserving the ban on runtime receiver and accepted-state controls.

runtime_receiver_gate_decision.reason: MWORKS/ROS2 live command-echo transport provenance remains unavailable; current checkers still report current_live_echo_receiver_present=false and safe_to_implement_runtime_receiver_next=false.

compile_gate_decision.reason: 009 did not edit UE source and PMO explicitly forbids Unreal build unless a future compile gate is dispatched. 006 already supplies compile-only evidence for the current state component and source-label patch.

overclaim_risks.risk: 007/008 future-live fixture rows may be misread as live evidence.
overclaim_risks.mitigation: Return packets and checkers explicitly state runtime_receiver_implemented=false, ui_asset_binding_implemented=false, and not_runtime_ue_console=true.

overclaim_risks.risk: Frame/status UDP receiver might be reused as command ack receiver.
overclaim_risks.mitigation: Receiver boundary checker and recommended next gate forbid mixing quadrotor.unreal_state frame downlink with mosim.ue_command_echo.v1 acknowledgement.
